why_this_addendum_exists: Run 1 failed both gates and is preserved unchanged in PHASE3E_RESULTS.json. Its held-out fixtures are spent, and two defects were found by running them. (1) A catalogue defect of mine: several geometries contained exactly one producer of the contract output type, so the pre-registered damage policy selected that unique producer and the function became unrecoverable by construction - the episode measured my catalogue, not the substrate. (2) A substrate measurement defect: partition_around() deleted the bond and execute() attempted no delivery, so no evidence of a partition existed and all 10 partition episodes were inferred as supplier_loss. Neither was repaired and rescored against run 1's fixtures. Fresh seeds and a corrected catalogue are pre-registered here instead.

corrections_made_before_this_commit.substrate: partitions now LEAVE THE BOND IN PLACE and execute() records a refused delivery, so isolation is distinguishable from a supplier that no longer exists; the diagnostician blames the far end of a refused edge rather than the consumer that noticed the starvation
corrections_made_before_this_commit.fixtures: verification/phase3e/geometries2.py gives every geometry at least two distinct producers of the contract output type. geometries.py is preserved unchanged so run 1 stays exactly reproducible.

holdout_integrity_statement: The corrected catalogue has never been executed before this commit. No probe, no test, no runner. If a geometry fails, the failure is reported and the substrate is not tuned to make it pass.
pre_registration_method: Git ancestry. Committed alone before run_phase3e2.py exists and before any run-2 results file.
